newsitem.title: USA: American Pad & Paper buys Wisc. paper maker.
newsitem.headline: American Pad & Paper buys Wisc. paper maker.

text.p: American Pad & Paper Co said Tuesday it is entering the machine papers business with a definitive agreement to buy Shade-Allied Inc of Green Bay, Wisconsin, for $51.5 million cash.
Shade-Allied has manufacturing plants in four states and about $90 million in 1996 sales, American Pad & Paper said.
The deal should close this month.
The company said the purchase of Shade-Allied is its seventh acquisition since 1992 and said it expects to make more acquisitions.
